email_templates.name: Automatic acknowledgement
email_templates.description: Sent once to a customer whose email opens a new ticket, when the department's "Receiving a new ticket" notification rule is on (Setup → Customization → Notifications).
email_templates.subject: Re: {{ticket.subject}} [#{{ticket.number}}]
email_templates.body_html:
Thanks for getting in touch. We have your message and it is now ticket #{{ticket.number}}.

Replying to this email adds to the same ticket, so there is no need to send it again.

email_templates.name: Ticket closed
email_templates.description: Sent when a ticket is closed, carrying the Customer Happiness rating link.
email_templates.subject: Your ticket #{{ticket.number}} has been closed
email_templates.body_html:
Hello,

Your ticket #{{ticket.number}} "{{ticket.subject}}" has been closed. If you need anything else, just reply to this email.

{{happiness.link}}

email_templates.name: Resolution notification
email_templates.description: Sent when an agent saves a resolution and chooses to notify the customer.
email_templates.subject: Re: {{ticket.subject}}

email_templates.name: Public comment
email_templates.description: Sent to the customer as a new email of its own — not inside the ticket's conversation — when an agent posts a public comment.
email_templates.subject: New comment on ticket #{{ticket.number}}: {{ticket.subject}}

email_templates.name: QA AO WF P16 template
email_templates.subject: QA AO WF P16 workflow email {{ticket.number}}
email_templates.body_html: QA AO WF P16 workflow email for ticket {{ticket.number}}: {{ticket.subject}}

email_templates.name: Reply acknowledgement
email_templates.description: Sent to a customer whose email adds to an existing ticket, when the "Acknowledging a ticket reply" rule is on.
email_templates.subject: Re: {{ticket.subject}} [#{{ticket.number}}]
email_templates.body_html: Thanks — we have your reply on ticket #{{ticket.number}} and will get back to you shortly.

email_templates.name: Public comment updated
email_templates.description: Sent to the customer, answering the comment's own email, when an agent edits a public comment.
email_templates.subject: Re: New comment on ticket #{{ticket.number}}: {{ticket.subject}}
email_templates.body_html:
A comment on your ticket #{{ticket.number}} was updated:

{{comment.content}}

email_templates.name: Public comment removed
email_templates.description: Sent to the customer, answering the comment's own email, when an agent removes a public comment. The removed text is never repeated.
email_templates.subject: Re: New comment on ticket #{{ticket.number}}: {{ticket.subject}}
email_templates.body_html: A comment on your ticket #{{ticket.number}} was removed.

email_templates.name: Added as a copied address
email_templates.description: Sent to an address an agent adds to a ticket's CC list, when the "Adding CCs to an existing ticket" rule is on.
email_templates.subject: You were added to ticket #{{ticket.number}}: {{ticket.subject}}
email_templates.body_html: You have been added to ticket #{{ticket.number}} "{{ticket.subject}}" and will receive its updates. Replying to this email adds to the same ticket.

email_templates.name: SLA escalation
email_templates.description: Sent to the agents, roles and teams an SLA escalation level names when a ticket is about to be late or is late. An escalation level may pick another SLA escalation template instead.
email_templates.subject: [SLA] #{{ticket.number}} {{sla.obligation}} — level {{sla.level}} ({{sla.timing}})
email_templates.body_html:
Ticket #{{ticket.number}} "{{ticket.subject}}" needs attention.

Policy: {{sla.policy}} / {{sla.target}}
Obligation: {{sla.obligation}}
Escalation level: {{sla.level}} ({{sla.timing}} the deadline)
Due: {{sla.due_at}}

Open the ticket: {{ticket.agent_link}}
